description: This file implements the map_labels class for managing map labels in the Wesnoth game, including label creation, reading, writing, scrolling, and shroud recalculations.

classes.name: map_labels
classes.description: Class for managing labels on the game map, including adding, removing, scrolling, and recalculating labels based on shroud status.

methods.name: map_labels
methods.description: Constructor initializing map_labels with display and map references.

methods.name: map_labels
methods.description: Overloaded constructor that also reads configuration.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes labels into a config object.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads label data from a config object.

methods.name: get_label
methods.description: Returns the label text for a given map location.

methods.name: set_label
methods.description: Sets a label at a specific map location, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Moves all labels by specified x and y offsets.

methods.name: recalculate_labels
methods.description: Recreates all labels, useful after changes in map or display.

methods.name: recalculate_shroud
methods.description: Updates label visibility based on shroud status.
